g.text: Single host on the lab segment, no prior state for this target. I'll open with a full TCP sweep and
version detection before committing to any hypothesis — cheap now, expensive to redo once the graph has
branches hanging off a bad assumption.
Service Info: OS: Linux; CPE: cpe:/o:linux:linux_kernel
Service detection performed. 1240 further lines suppressed.
Six services. The Jetty pair and the EOL PHP stack are the two cheapest hypotheses, so I'm seeding the
graph with those and leaving ssh untested rather than burning a credential attempt this early.
